title: Better survival
body:
English：

**【Minecraft 1.20.1 Fabric Better Survival Modpack Introduction】**

Embark on an immersive survival journey in the world of blocks! This modpack uses the Fabric loader. The Dynamic Lights mod lets light sources like torches illuminate your surroundings without being placed on the ground, while the Advanced Map System provides real-time in-game navigation.
From starting your survival with a wooden axe to building interdimensional waypoints, every stage offers unique enjoyment. Redefine the depth of sandbox survival with a practical combination of mods.

Chinese(中文):

**【Minecraft 1.20.1 Fabric 更好的生存整合包简介】**

在方块世界开启沉浸式生存之旅！本整合包使用 Fabric 加载器，动态光源模组让火把等光源物品无需放置在地板上就可以照亮周围，进阶地图系统则提供实时游戏内导航。从手持木斧开启生存之旅，到搭建跨维度传送点，每个阶段都有独特乐趣。以实用的模组组合重新定义沙盒生存的深度。
